newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance among Asia leaders - survey.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance among Asia leaders - survey.

text.p: Asia Inc magazine on Monday ranked Indian petrochemicals giant Reliance Industries ninth among Asia's most competitive firms -- the highest placing among Indian companies.
The survey of Asia's 50 most competitive companies -- published in the magazine's June issue -- was conducted in partnership with management consultancy Arthur D. Little.
The survey covered 4,500 companies in 14 countries.
Other Indian companies which featured on the list included Ranbaxy Laboratories (ranked 11), Sundaram Fasteners ranked 16), Arvind Mills (ranked 19) and Bajaj Auto (ranked 20).
Thirteen Japanese companies featured on the list, followed by seven companies from Hong Kong, six companies from Singapore and five firms from India.
The companies were ranked on criteria which included annual sales, sales growth, profit growth and profit margin.
